 OPPO Reno 17, Reno 17c India price range tipped; series could start above Rs 50,000
 By Saloni Tandon - Published On: 16 November 2026 | 15:53 IST Highlights The OPPO Reno 17c could launch in India above Rs 50,000, while the standard Reno 17 is tipped to cost over Rs 70,000. 
 The Reno 17c is expected to feature a Dimensity 7300 chipset, a 50MP triple rear camera setup and a plastic frame. 
 Both phones could arrive in India in December, following the Reno 17 series’ China launch on November 16th. 
 OPPO is said to be preparing to bring the OPPO Reno 17 and Reno 17c to India in December, with the upcoming lineup tipped to carry higher starting prices than its predecessors. The predecessors, the OPPO Reno 16 and Reno 16c , launched in the country in July this year, with the latter being the cheaper option, starting under Rs 50,000. If the new tip is to be believed, the “mid-range” series could well be pushing past the Rs 50,000-mark with the latest launches. 
 Table of Contents
 OPPO Reno 17c and Reno 17 India launch timeline, expected price 
 OPPO Reno 17 series upgrades over Reno 16 
 OPPO Reno17 5G Images 
 OPPO Reno 17c and Reno 17 India launch timeline, expected price 
 According to tipster Gadgetsdata , the OPPO Reno 17c could cost above Rs 50,000, while the standard Reno 17 could be priced above Rs 70,000. The Reno 17 series is scheduled to debut in China today , i.e November 16th, but that would only be the Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro. The OPPO Reno 17c could come later to India directly. 
 As per the tipster, t he Reno 17c is tipped to feature the MediaTek Dimensity 7300 chipset and a plastic frame. Its camera setup could include a 50MP primary camera with OIS, an 8MP ultrawide camera and a 50MP telephoto camera with 3.5x optical zoom and OIS. A 50MP front camera is also expected. 
 The standard Reno 17, meanwhile, is tipped to feature a metal frame and Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset. Its rear camera setup will comprise a 50MP OIS primary camera, a 50MP ultrawide camera and a 50MP 3.5x telephoto camera with OIS. Both phones are expected to feature flat 1.5K OLED displays with 120Hz refresh rates, UFS 3.1 storage, a dedicated Snap Key and 80W charging. The Reno 17c could pack a battery of around 7,000mAh, while tipster Digital Chat Station has tipped an 8,000mAh battery for the standard Reno 17. 
 OPPO Reno 17 series upgrades over Reno 16 
 The Reno 16 and Reno 16c launched in India in July starting at Rs 61,999 and Rs 46,999, respectively. The Reno 16c’s 50MP main, 8MP ultrawide and 50MP 3.5x telephoto cameras are largely similar to the setup tipped for its successor. Its Dimensity 7300-Energy chipset also belongs to the same processor family as the Reno 17c’s reported Dimensity 7300. The newer model could bring a higher-resolution 1.5K display, but the leaked specifications don’t suggest a substantial performance upgrade. 
 The standard Reno 17 has a more interesting battery upgrade over the Reno 16’s 6,700mAh unit, with the leaked 8,000mAh capacity. Its 6.56-inch display would also be larger than the Reno 16’s compact 6.32-inch panel. However, the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 is the same chipset used by the Reno 16, so buyers shouldn’t expect a major performance jump. 
 If the reported prices hold, both models will face a tougher value proposition. The Reno 17c would start above the Reno 16c’s original Rs 46,999 price, while the standard Reno 17 could cost at least Rs 8,000 more than the Reno 16’s starting price. The larger batteries and telephoto cameras may appeal to photography enthusiasts, but OPPO will need to justify the higher prices with meaningful improvements beyond battery capacity and display size.
